 About the match
 On this page you can find the Tijuana vs Santos Laguna match lineup for Liga MX — Round 14 - First Leg, on Monday 26-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Tijuana lines up in a 4-5-1 led by Rodríguez, while Santos Laguna sets up in a 5-4-1 led by Pardo. Tijuana is led by head coach Sebastian Abreu, while Santos Laguna is managed by Renato Paiva. The match is played at Estadio Caliente.
